roles.name: NEXT F Super Admin
roles.description: Internal platform root role containing every permission that is eligible for NEXT F Admin.
notes: Must be tightly limited and protected with strong authentication.

roles.name: NEXT F Platform Operator
roles.description: Internal operational role for Organizations, Sites, diagnostics, support, integration health and delivery diagnostics without contract/permission authority.

roles.name: NEXT F Support
roles.description: Internal support role with diagnostic and customer-context read access plus bounded lead/order support operations.

roles.name: Organization Owner
roles.description: Highest standard customer role for one Organization. Uses explicit permissions only and cannot receive platform-only authority.
notes: System-protected reference role; customers may create narrower custom roles instead of modifying this baseline.

roles.name: Website Administrator
roles.description: Broad Site-scoped administration for one Website Workspace without Organization membership, role-assignment, secret-management or NEXT F platform authority.

roles.name: Content Editor
roles.description: Creates and edits structured website content but does not approve, publish or delete it.

roles.name: Content Publisher
roles.description: Reviews, approves and publishes content while retaining only bounded editing authority.

roles.name: Blog Editor
roles.description: Creates and edits Blog content, taxonomy, authors and media without publish/delete authority.

roles.name: SEO Manager
roles.description: Manages SEO configuration, redirects, audits, indexing and search-performance data without general content administration.

roles.name: Commerce Manager
roles.description: Operates catalog, inventory, customers, orders, fulfillment, promotions, returns and authorized refunds while excluding direct payment-administration authority.

roles.name: Marketing Manager
roles.description: Manages analytics, campaign attribution, conversions, consent-aware destinations and standard marketing integrations.

roles.name: Lead Manager
roles.description: Works with form submissions, lead qualification, assignments and notifications without form-design or destructive access.

roles.name: Support Agent
roles.description: Customer support role for leads, order context and returns without payment, publishing or integration-management authority.

roles.name: Viewer
roles.description: Read-only role across customer-eligible Site information without secret or credential visibility.

schemas.name: Principal Reference
schemas.description: Identifies the authenticated human or trusted service principal participating in authorization.
schemas.purpose: Identifies the authenticated human or trusted service principal participating in authorization.

fields.description: Opaque canonical identifier for the principal.

validationRules.description: principalId must be opaque and must not embed email addresses or secrets.
A principal type must be recognized before authorization evaluation.

schemas.name: Scope Binding
schemas.description: Binds a role assignment or permission evaluation to platform, Organization, Site, resource or self scope.
schemas.purpose: Binds a role assignment or permission evaluation to platform, Organization, Site, resource or self scope.

fields.description: Canonical resource identifier when using resource scope.
Opaque resource identifier when using resource scope.

validationRules.description: Site scope requires a siteId.
Organization scope requires an organizationId.
Resource scope requires resourceType and resourceId plus a valid parent Organization/Site boundary.

schemas.name: Permission Definition
schemas.description: Authoritative metadata for one canonical domain.resource.action permission identifier.
schemas.purpose: Authoritative metadata for one canonical domain.resource.action permission identifier.

validationRules.description: permissionId must exactly equal domain.resource.action.
Permission identifiers are immutable once stable.
A non-grantable permission cannot be placed in customer-defined roles.

schemas.name: Role Definition
schemas.description: Defines a named bundle of explicit canonical permissions with scope and assignment constraints.
schemas.purpose: Defines a named bundle of explicit canonical permissions with scope and assignment constraints.

fields.description: Explicit canonical permission IDs; wildcards are prohibited.

validationRules.description: Role permission lists must contain only canonical permission IDs.
Wildcard permission grants are prohibited.
A customer-defined role cannot contain a permission outside the creator’s grantable permission ceiling.

schemas.name: Role Assignment
schemas.description: Assigns one role to one principal within an explicit authorization scope.
schemas.purpose: Assigns one role to one principal within an explicit authorization scope.

validationRules.description: Assignments are inactive outside their time window.
A Site-scoped role cannot authorize another Site.
Suspended or revoked assignments grant no permissions.

schemas.name: Authorization Context
schemas.description: Trusted server-side context used to evaluate whether a principal may perform a requested action.
schemas.purpose: Trusted server-side context used to evaluate whether a principal may perform a requested action.

validationRules.description: Browser-supplied Organization/Site identifiers are context inputs, not proof of access.
Authorization context must be assembled by trusted server-side code.

schemas.name: Authorization Decision
schemas.description: Records the result and rationale of a permission evaluation without exposing secrets.
schemas.purpose: Records the result and rationale of a permission evaluation without exposing secrets.

validationRules.description: Default decision is deny when no valid grant matches.
Decision records must not include secrets or raw authentication tokens.

schemas.name: Policy Condition
schemas.description: Optional bounded condition metadata for high-risk permission evaluation.
schemas.purpose: Optional bounded condition metadata for high-risk permission evaluation.

validationRules.description: Conditions cannot create permissions that the principal does not already hold.
Conditions may narrow an existing grant but cannot silently broaden its scope.

schemas.name: Permission Check
schemas.description: Canonical request shape for checking one exact permission against one trusted scope.
schemas.purpose: Canonical request shape for checking one exact permission against one trusted scope.

validationRules.description: Permission checks use exact canonical identifiers.
No wildcard matching is permitted in authorization decisions.

actions.label: View
actions.description: Read permitted records, configuration or operational information without modifying it.

actions.label: Create
actions.description: Create a new resource instance within the authorized scope.

actions.label: Edit
actions.description: Modify an existing resource without granting broader administrative authority.

actions.label: Delete
actions.description: Remove or request removal of a resource where the underlying contract permits deletion.

actions.label: Publish
actions.description: Move publishable content into a publicly deliverable state where contract rules permit.

actions.label: Approve
actions.description: Approve content or workflow state independently from ordinary editing.

actions.label: Manage
actions.description: Perform resource-specific operational or administrative actions not represented by narrower actions.

actions.label: Export
actions.description: Export permitted records or reports from the authorized scope.

scopeKinds.label: Platform
scopeKinds.description: Applies across the NEXT F platform and is restricted to NEXT F privileged administration.

scopeKinds.label: Organization
scopeKinds.description: Applies to one NEXT F customer Organization and its authorized child Sites where explicitly permitted.

scopeKinds.label: Site
scopeKinds.description: Applies to one customer Site / Customer CMS Workspace.

scopeKinds.label: Resource
scopeKinds.description: Applies to a specific resource instance beneath an Organization or Site scope.

scopeKinds.label: Self
scopeKinds.description: Applies only to the principal’s own profile or self-service data.

riskLevels.label: Standard
riskLevels.description: Routine read or low-impact operational permission.

riskLevels.label: Elevated
riskLevels.description: Can materially change customer content or operational state.

riskLevels.label: Sensitive
riskLevels.description: Can expose or change personal, financial, integration or security-sensitive information.

riskLevels.label: Destructive
riskLevels.description: Can delete, revoke, cancel or irreversibly remove important state.

riskLevels.label: Privileged
riskLevels.description: Can change platform authority, security boundaries, contracts, roles or other high-impact administration.

surfaces.label: Automation
surfaces.description: Trusted background automation or service execution.

authorizationDefaults.customerCustomRolePermissionCeiling: grantable permissions already held by the role creator within the same scope
